title: Window Fullscreen Cap Left Border
description: The fullscreen/maximize control cap on mode dock windows is missing the left border line in both normal and active states. Restore border-l on windowControlsCap* classes.
summary: The mode-dock maximize (fullscreen) control cap used `!border-l-0`, which removed the left chrome line in inactive and active stacks. Aligned `windowControlsCapClass`, `windowControlsCapActiveClass`, and `windowControlsCapActiveSplitClass` with the tab cap by using `border-x` instead of `border-r` plus `!border-l-0`. Extended Mode layout tests to assert `border-x` on controls caps and no `border-l-0`.
